enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +21: Passive: +21 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+7 Enhancement Bonus: +7 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Shield Bashing +20%: +20% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Natural Armor +6: Passive: +6 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +60 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Devotion +114: Passive: +114 Equipment bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Damage Reduction 15/Slashing: Reduces physical damage by 15, except from Slashing attacks.
